series_end_reason: From the Q1 2026 report Tresiba is no longer a separate line; it sits within 'Long-acting insulin' (footnote: 'Comprises Tresiba, Xultophy, Levemir and Awiqli').
series_start_reason: Launched March 2013 (stated in the 2015-2016 reports) but, apart from the first quarters of 2013 and 2014, the 2013-2015 reports print Tresiba only inside the combined 'new-generation insulin' line (Tresiba, Ryzodeg, Xultophy). Tresiba-only year-to-date figures for 2015 exist only in running text whose label and figures the checker cannot tie together, so the series starts where Tresiba is a table line: Q1 2016.
search_log: listed all CIK 0000353278 filings via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + CIK0000353278-submissions-001.json): 2,045 filings, of which 1,788 are 6-K and 25 are 20-F and 4 are 20-F/A; zero 8-K, 8-K/A or 10-Q forms (foreign private issuer)

6-K quarterly financial reports (company announcements): 2019Q1-2026Q2 are exhibits named caq{q}{yyyy}.htm; 2009-2018 identified by size filter on the submissions index (reports are the 6-Ks >200 kB filed in each reporting window), then confirmed by opening each

the EDGAR copies of the Q1 2018 and Q2 2018 reports (0001628280-18-005610, 0001628280-18-010747) render all tables as JPEG page images (about 30 page images each, no text tables); the same reports as published on novonordisk.com (PDF) were used for those two quarters
